entries.056113c930b1fb35: Under its long-term vision 'BGI 2032', the company aims to grow into a global brand that masters 'Sauce', and sets 3 basic strategies: domestic strategy, overseas strategy and VC (value chain) strategy. In Japan it will expand in both household and commercial markets; overseas it will expand exports and localize centered on the Shanghai local subsidiary; and under the VC strategy it will pursue stable supply of raw materials and improved productivity.

entries.9b3613a83a48268b: BULL-DOG SAUCE CO.,LTD. is a seasoning maker with 3 consolidated subsidiaries, and its consolidated headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 282 employees. Its head office is located in Kabutocho, Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and its production centers on the TATEBAYASHI Creation Center in Tatebayashi, Gunma Prefecture.

Overseas, exports and the Shanghai local subsidiary sell its products.

entries.ac97d17d3a21fa42: This is a business in a single segment that manufactures and sells sauces. It consists of the company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries (Ikari Sauce Co., Ltd., Sunfoods Co., Ltd., and Tomotokkyaku Foods (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.). The center of production is the TATEBAYASHI Creation Center in Tatebayashi City, Gunma Prefecture, and Ikari Sauce Co., Ltd. produces at its Nishinomiya Plant in Nishinomiya City, Hyogo Prefecture. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥14,600,008,000 plus ¥8,000,000.

entries.f8ec51de6ee81b00: Since its founding in 1902 and the start of sauce production in 1905, the company has continued as a sauce-specialized seasoning maker whose main products are regular sauces such as Worcester, Chūnō and tonkatsu sauces, and it states its aim of establishing its presence as a sauce maker.
